prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
blank_sentence: After studying the telescope's record of the event, one astronomer described the dimming as ______.

worlds.passage: In 2019 an orbiting telescope that tracks the brightness of thousands of stars recorded a drop in the light of one star that had shone steadily for years. The star fell to half its usual brightness within an hour, and by the next evening it was shining at its old level again. In the five years since, the telescope has checked it every thirty minutes without once catching it dim, even slightly, a second time. After studying the telescope's record of the event, one astronomer described the dimming as ______.
worlds.explanation: The dimming came and went within about a day and has never recurred in five years of close watching, so it was "transient." "Shallow" fails because the star fell to half its brightness; "stepwise" fails because it fell in one plunge within an hour; "symmetric" fails because the fall took an hour while the recovery took until the next evening.

shallow.why: Losing half its light is a deep drop.

stepwise.why: A single plunge did not come in a series of stages.

symmetric.why: A recovery that took far longer than the hour-long fall does not mirror it.

worlds.passage: In 2019 an orbiting telescope that tracks the brightness of thousands of stars recorded a drop in the light of one star that had shone steadily for years. The loss came to less than one part in a thousand of the star's light, a change no backyard telescope could register, and it came on gradually over three weeks. Five years later the star has not regained that sliver of light and is still shining at the lower level. After studying the telescope's record of the event, one astronomer described the dimming as ______.
worlds.explanation: The star lost less than a thousandth of its light, too little for an ordinary telescope to detect, so the dimming was "shallow." "Transient" fails because five years later the star is still at the lower level; "stepwise" fails because the loss came on gradually; "symmetric" fails because there has been no recovery to mirror the fall.

transient.quote: still shining at the lower level
transient.why: A dimming that has lasted five years and counting is not short-lived.

stepwise.quote: came on gradually over three weeks
stepwise.why: A gradual loss did not come in distinct stages.

symmetric.why: With no recovery at all, there is no second half to mirror the fall.

worlds.passage: In 2019 an orbiting telescope that tracks the brightness of thousands of stars recorded a drop in the light of one star that had shone steadily for years. Over the next two months the light fell by half, holding level for days at a time between four abrupt drops of about an eighth each. Astronomers think four dense clouds of dust drifted one after another between the star and us, and five years later, with the clouds still in place, it remains at half its old brightness. After studying the telescope's record of the event, one astronomer described the dimming as ______.
worlds.explanation: The light fell in four abrupt drops with level stretches between them, one for each cloud of dust, so the dimming was "stepwise." "Transient" fails because the clouds are still in place five years later; "shallow" fails because the light fell by half; "symmetric" fails because the star has never recovered, so nothing mirrors the fall.

transient.quote: with the clouds still in place
transient.why: A dimming that has lasted five years and counting is not short-lived.

shallow.why: Losing half its light is a deep drop.

symmetric.quote: remains at half its old brightness
symmetric.why: With no recovery at all, there is no second half to mirror the fall.

worlds.passage: In 2019 an orbiting telescope that tracks the brightness of thousands of stars recorded a drop in the light of one star that had shone steadily for years. A faint companion star that circles it every eleven years was passing in front, and at the deepest point its dark disk covered half the bright star's face. The companion crossed at an unchanging speed, so the light faded smoothly as more of the face was hidden and returned as it was uncovered, and the same ten-month dip is expected again in 2030. After studying the telescope's record of the event, one astronomer described the dimming as ______.
worlds.explanation: A disk crossing at constant speed uncovers the star exactly as it covered it, so the recovery retraced the fall and the dimming was "symmetric." "Transient" fails because the dip lasts ten months and returns every eleven years; "shallow" fails because half the star's face was covered; "stepwise" fails because the light faded smoothly.

transient.quote: the same ten-month dip is expected again
transient.why: A long dip that recurs on a schedule is not a brief, one-time event.

shallow.quote: covered half the bright star's face
shallow.why: Hiding half the star is a deep drop.

stepwise.quote: faded smoothly as more of the face was hidden
stepwise.why: A smooth fade did not come in distinct stages.
